[Post Detail] 1. Likes Post Report and Documentation

Tested by :

Project :

Description of Feature :

"Likes Post" enables users to express appreciation for panoramic posts on Panorra. Users can like or unlike posts with immediate visual feedback, optimistic counter updates, filled heart icon indicators, and automated authorization prompts for unauthenticated guests.

Device :

  • AMD Ryzen 3 4300U (8GB) Windows 10
  • Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-4570 (8GB) Windows 10
  • Android 13 (8GB)

Main Functions :

Title Scenario
Description : User can like and unlike a panorama post with real-time counter updates.
Actor : User
Interface : Mobile Responsive and Web App
Pre-Condition : User opens Panorra app and navigates to Post Detail
Basic Flow : Actor System
- User opens post detail page
- User clicks heart icon button
- Updates heart icon to active red solid
- Increments like counter by 1
- Sends POST /posts/like request
- User clicks heart icon again
- Reverts heart icon to outline
- Decrements like counter by 1
- Dispatches unlike request
Correct scenario and corresponding result : User successfully likes and unlikes the post with accurate count updates
Correct scenario and incorrect result : Validate network failure triggers optimistic rollback
Incorrect scenario and corresponding result : Validate guest user click opens login prompt without dispatching like request
